text: Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority to appoint and remove directors from the boards of Businesses Improvement Areas (BIAs) that fall within its geographic boundaries. The purpose of this motion is to amend item EY24.11 to make changes to Business Improvement Areas Boards of management by removing one member of the Weston Village BIA Board of Management

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Accepted the letter of resignation attached to the letter (July 2, 2025) from Councillor Frances Nunziata and removed the following director from the Weston Village Business Improvement Area Board of Management: - Masum Hossain
